blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — A 33-year-old man described by authorities as a former communist rebel and ranked as the Caraga region’s 10th most wanted person was arrested during a joint police and military operation in Trento, Agusan del Sur, on Tuesday, Oct. 20. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, director of Police Regional Office 13 (PRO-13), identified the suspect by his aliases “Jason,” “A1,” “Iker” and “Jesryl.” He is a resident of Hinatuan, Surigao del Sur. Authorities identified the suspect as a former combatant under the Sub-Regional Sentro de Grabidad (SRSDG) Southland of the New People’s Army’s North Eastern Mindanao Regional […]...
